text: なんか　つれる　までは　はずかしくて　いえに　かえれん

structure.jp: なんか　つれる　までは

patterns.name: 〜まで
patterns.explanation: まで after a verb means 'until' that happens, and は adds 'at least'. つれる　までは = 'at least until I catch something'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this part to the next, and here it gives the reason. はずかしくて = 'I'd be so embarrassed that'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing かえる to かえれる adds 'can', and ん is an older man's or dialect form of ない. かえれん is かえれない = 'I can't go home'.
